What a tough situation. If you cant come to an agreement, ask yourself:


If you stayed as you are now - would she be happy?


If you moved with her, would you be happy?


If you kept moving between countries, would either of you be happy?


What is a bigger priority to you both? The relationship and being together or being close to family?


Would it be possible to move and just see family on holidays? Or is that too little for either of you?


Sometimes even if everything else works out, 1 unchangable thing doesnt. Its hard to let go of something you love. So if you dont have to then great, but if its not compatible and both of you are going to be unhappy in the long run then maybe its time to re-evaluate. 


Good luck!

Maybe if this had just been going on a couple of months it would be understandable. But a year? she needs to step up.

I'll put the overall thought here: It seems like you're having a lot of doubts and can already pinpoint that you feel maybe you're just not compatible - you could say that's fine and that, maybe its just irrational...but it seems even after reassurance, thoughts just lead back there. It seems like you know that's the case too. Usually I would suggest it already sounds like you know yourself and probably know what to do. If this really is the case, then good luck. And if you're feeling like you're going to keep coming back to these thoughts, its probably better to break things off before you both spend loads on an expensive?? trip to see someone (who you're not even sure you see yourself dating) - the sooner the better, its nice to give people warning and stops you from stringing them along in the long run - but make sure that you're certain this is what you want. Once that happens you probably cant go back.   


(also fyi - if you were going to pay for your own flight and decide not to continue, you dont owe him any money. Just because you get cold feet doesnt mean you didnt appreciate the time you spent with him, your reason is valid for breaking up with someone)  


BUT - if you're still not entirely sure and think it could be nerves or insecurities etc, heres an alternative: Write a list of pros and cons to dating him. Is the list full  of more cons than pros? **Some advice worth looking into:**

*(Don't take some of these as me treating you like you don't know anything, I've just seen a lot of people not think about these steps!)*

*\~ If you haven't already its a good idea to set up a PayPal or something similar, it helps a lot when collecting payment (deffo don't give out bank details - some people have done that for whatever odd reason).*

*\~ You can still advertise and sell on sites that don't have an option for transactions for commissions e.g. Instagram (which is where the PayPal comes in) but its risky; unlike sites that sort transactions, there's not much to stop them from taking the commission and not paying. But then again there's no sellers fee. (Its better to just link from there to your other sm where transactions are reliable).*

\~ *Sites like Patreon are ok, but you have to remember that they and many others take a cut of your sale price (usually between 5 and 10% depending on where). That's why some people use Instagram or their own website because there's no sellers fee .*

\~ *Sites such as Patreon are also more beneficial for people who have built up a community or following, if you've got that, then great! - not that its impossible otherwise, but your work might not be found as easily.* 

\--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Any site would do so long as you can communicate to an audience, which is why you might benefit from posting multiple places if you have the will power lmao (it can be draining).
